newsitem.title: USA: Immulogic delays ragweed product trials.
newsitem.headline: Immulogic delays ragweed product trials.

text.p: Biopharmaceutical company ImmuLogic Pharmaceutical Corp said Thursday it had suspended clinical trials of a ragweed product until it had provided more information to the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
The company said it had to provide the information before it could go ahead with the trial of its Allervax Ragweed product, which was originally scheduled for July.

"Because the trial must be conducted in the summer ragweed season, the additional time required to respond to the FDA request will delay the potential initiation of the study until the summer of 1998," it said.
ImmuLogic develops products to treat allergies and diseases of the immune system.
